=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/mcp-usage-monitoring-plan.md:121-217 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan defines `other_mcp_fallbacks` and tells the analyst to treat generic `<NAME>_FALLBACK` telemetry as unknown MCP data, but it only specifies `MCP_QUERY_GENERIC_RE`, so there is no parser path for third-party fallback lines.
  WHY: An implementation following the doc would leave `other_mcp_fallbacks` empty while the prompt asks the analyst to reason about data the parser never emits.
- PR check-runs context:N/A | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The required `lint` check-run is failing on the PR head and blocks merge.
  WHY: All three reviewers observed the red status check, though they disagreed on whether the cause is pre-existing or introduced by the new markdown file.
- docs/mcp-usage-monitoring-plan.md:37-38 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Section 1.2 says the contractual prefixes are in `agents.md:142-146`, but that range includes Semble prefixes, not the Serena trio.
  WHY: Readers checking the cited lines will see the wrong contract block and waste time reconciling the mismatch.
- docs/mcp-usage-monitoring-plan.md:1-349 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The PR has no title or description.
  WHY: That hurts discoverability and intent parsing even though the commit carries the context.
- docs/mcp-usage-monitoring-plan.md:125-130 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `SERENA_QUERY_RE` uses `(?:^|\s)` / `(?:\s|$)` anchoring that can match `SERENA_QUERY` inside malformed or quoted transcript text.
  WHY: That would inflate telemetry by counting substrings that are not standalone log prefixes.
- docs/mcp-usage-monitoring-plan.md:157-199 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The plan extracts `reason=` from `SERENA_FALLBACK` but says it is unused downstream while the analyst prompt asks to correlate fallbacks, so the reason signal has no defined consumer.
  WHY: An implementation would collect a field the analysis workflow cannot use for the requested correlation, leaving fallback root-cause analysis incomplete.
- docs/mcp-usage-monitoring-plan.md:136-149 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The plan adds a `serena_query_tool_calls` scalar while also introducing a per-tool `serena_tools` dict, duplicating the same data without a clear use for the aggregate scalar.
  WHY: That risks inconsistent totals and confusing output when the per-tool table already contains the tool-call counts.
- docs/mcp-usage-monitoring-plan.md:242-246 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The plan only says to verify deep-dive scoring and does not establish that `collect_workflow_logs.py` is already prefix-agnostic, so `SERENA_*` lines could be dropped if the scorer still hardcodes `SEMBLE_`.
  WHY: If that happens the analyst never sees Serena evidence in excerpts and the downstream prompt edits would not take effect.
- docs/mcp-usage-monitoring-plan.md:290-346 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The work breakdown assumes answers to Q-PLAN-A/B/C, but the document still marks them as awaiting decisions.
  WHY: The implementation checklist cannot start cleanly until those choices are resolved, so shipping the plan as-is is premature.
- docs/mcp-usage-monitoring-plan.md:221-234 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Adding Serena accumulator fields may break the existing Semble metric tests if they assert exact JSON key sets or ordering.
  WHY: The plan says the old tests need no changes, but it does not verify that their assertions are schema-tolerant.
- docs/mcp-usage-monitoring-plan.md:31-32 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The plan references `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` for semantic context but never proposes a Serena-prefetch counterpart.
  WHY: Without a parallel `{{SERENA_PREFETCH}}`, Serena telemetry may be visible in parsed metrics yet absent from the prefetched analyst context.
- docs/mcp-usage-monitoring-plan.md:236-249 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The downstream-collector section omits `scripts/apply_audit_gate_assets.py` and `scripts/semantic_cache.py` as consumers of `cost_audit.py` output.
  WHY: Those consumers could ignore new keys or, in the cache case, potentially serve stale analysis if the data shape affects cache keys.
- docs/mcp-usage-monitoring-plan.md:103-109 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The proposed `MCP_*_QUERY` catch-all can match literal `_QUERY` text inside quoted Codex transcript lines and turn it into fake MCP telemetry.
  WHY: That would inflate `other_mcp_query_calls` with prompt text rather than actual prefixes, so the mitigation needs stronger wording.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  WHY: As written, third-party fallback lines would never populate `other_mcp_fallbacks`, and the analyst guidance would ask for data the parser cannot emit.
